semiconductor_relevance: High — Canon ANELVA specializes in vacuum equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on thin-film deposition processes.
summary: Canon ANELVA provides advanced vacuum equipment for semiconductor and electronic component manufacturing, including the 'Adastra' series for thin-film deposition. Their offerings include sputtering and wafer bonding equipment designed to enhance productivity and reduce energy consumption.
capabilities: Sputtering systems for metal wiring materials
Wafer bonding equipment using atomic diffusion bonding
Mixed Reality demonstrations for equipment experience
